_comment: WebSocket payload samples for the 2geda chat system.

connection.description: Sent by the server after a successful WebSocket handshake.

send.description: Client sends a text message to a conversation.

client_to_server.body: Hey, are you free for a call?

broadcast.description: Server broadcasts the new message to all members of the conversation group.

server_to_client.body: Hey, are you free for a call?

mark_read.description: Client marks a conversation as read. Server broadcasts a read receipt.

start.description: Client signals that the user started typing.

stop.description: Client signals that the user stopped typing.

broadcast.description: Server relays the typing indicator to every member in the conversation.

online.description: Server notifies conversation members when a user comes online.

offline.description: Server notifies conversation members when a user goes offline.

rest_query.description: REST endpoint to check online status of arbitrary users.

ping.description: Client sends every 30 seconds to keep the connection alive and refresh presence TTL.

call_audio.description: Full flow for an audio-only WebRTC call between two users sharing a conversation.

offer.step: 1. Caller sends SDP offer to the server, which relays it to the peer.

client_to_server.sdp:
v=0
o=- 123456 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0
a=msid-semantic: WMS
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=rtcp-mux
a=mid:0
a=sendrecv
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2
a=ssrc:123456 cname:audioCall

server_to_peer.sdp:
v=0
o=- 123456 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0
a=msid-semantic: WMS
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=rtcp-mux
a=mid:0
a=sendrecv
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2
a=ssrc:123456 cname:audioCall

answer.step: 2. Callee sends SDP answer back through the server.

client_to_server.sdp:
v=0
o=- 654321 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:0
a=recvonly
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2

server_to_caller.sdp:
v=0
o=- 654321 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:0
a=recvonly
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2

ice.step: 3. Both sides exchange ICE candidates until the connection is established.

call_video.description: Full flow for a video WebRTC call. Identical to audio except call_type is 'video' and the SDP includes a video m-line.

offer.step: 1. Caller sends a video SDP offer.

client_to_server.sdp:
v=0
o=- 789012 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0 1
a=msid-semantic: WMS
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:0
a=sendrecv
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2
m=video 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 96
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:1
a=sendrecv
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
a=fmtp:96 packetization-mode=1
a=ssrc:789012 cname:videoCall

server_to_peer.sdp:
v=0
o=- 789012 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0 1
a=msid-semantic: WMS
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:0
a=sendrecv
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2
m=video 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 96
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:1
a=sendrecv
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
a=fmtp:96 packetization-mode=1
a=ssrc:789012 cname:videoCall

answer.step: 2. Callee answers with a matching video SDP.

client_to_server.sdp:
v=0
o=- 345678 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0 1
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:0
a=recvonly
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2
m=video 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 96
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:1
a=recvonly
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000

server_to_caller.sdp:
v=0
o=- 345678 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0 1
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:0
a=recvonly
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2
m=video 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 96
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:1
a=recvonly
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000

ice.step: 3. ICE candidates (same payload as audio call).

end.step: 4. Either party ends the call (same payload as audio call).

video_toggle.description: Either participant enables or disables their camera mid-call.

screen_share.description: Either participant starts or stops sharing their screen.

call_missed.description: If the callee never answers, the caller sends call.end with reason 'no_answer'.

call_busy.description: If the callee is already in a call, send call.end with reason 'busy'.
